content: gh pr create base branch resolution order: --base flag, then the gh-merge-base git branch config, then the repo default branch. --head accepts user:branch (orgs unsupported). -R/--repo picks the base repo as [HOST/]OWNER/REPO. If the current branch is not fully pushed, gh PROMPTS interactively for where to push and offers to fork - which hangs a headless daemon. --fill uses commit info for title/body but explicit --title/--body win.
